prompt: One provider's accepted transactions sometimes show as unpaid. Normalise incoming gateway events so both providers' payloads are understood. GatewayEventNormalizer::normalize(string $provider, array $payload) must return an array with exactly the keys provider, eventId, paymentReference, status, amountCents, and currency. Both the older and newer Stripe-style and PayFast-style fixture payloads must be supported, status casing must be canonicalised to the documented values, amounts must be integer cents, and signature verification must remain enforced before any state change.
issue_title: Some accepted transactions show as unpaid in admin reports
issue_body: One provider's accepted transactions sometimes show as unpaid. Normalise incoming gateway events so both providers' payloads are understood. GatewayEventNormalizer::normalize(string $provider, array $payload) must return an array with exactly the keys provider, eventId, paymentReference, status, amountCents, and currency. Both the older and newer Stripe-style and PayFast-style fixture payloads must be supported, status casing must be canonicalised to the documented values, amounts must be integer cents, and signature verification must remain enforced before any state change.
expected_behavior: normalize returns the six documented keys for every supported payload.
Older and newer Stripe-style and PayFast-style payloads are all supported.
Status values are canonicalised regardless of casing.
Invalid signatures are rejected before any state change.
expected_failure_summary: GatewayEventNormalizer only handles the newer data.object / m_payment_id shapes and returns the raw provider status without canonicalisation, so older payloads come out empty and mixed-case statuses are not mapped to the documented values.
task_author_notes: Restore the old-shape else branches in normalizeStripe (event_id/payment_ref/amount_cents) and normalizePayFast (payment_id/reference/amount), and wrap status with PaymentStatus::normalize in both. old_stripe_payload, old_payfast_payload, and mixed_status_casing fail on broken; new_* and invalid_signature pass.
